checkIn.note: This is a validated screening questionnaire. There are no right or wrong answers, and you can stop at any time.

wording.unverifiedBody: This version of the questions has not been checked against a validated published form, so the score may be less reliable.

result.title: Your result
result.span: {unit, select, week {{count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}} other {{count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}
result.deterioration: Up {points} in {span}. That is more than normal day-to-day ups and downs, so it's worth acting on.
result.improvement: Down {points} in {span}. That is more than normal day-to-day ups and downs, which is encouraging.
result.steady: Within the normal ups and downs since your last check-in ({points}).
result.first: This is your first check-in of this kind. Check in again in a few weeks to see how you are changing.
result.whoFollowUp: Answer questions about mood and anxiety
result.notFound: We could not find that check-in on this phone.
result.unverified: The wording of these questions is not verified, so treat this score with care.

phq9.minimal: Your answers suggest few or no low-mood symptoms at the moment. Keep an eye on how you feel and check in again in a few weeks.
phq9.mild: Your answers suggest some low-mood symptoms. Many people feel this way at times, and simple self-help steps often help.
phq9.moderate: Your answers suggest low mood at a level where talking to a trained professional, such as a family doctor, usually helps.
phq9.moderately_severe: Your answers suggest low mood that is affecting your days quite a lot. Talking to a trained professional soon is recommended.
phq9.severe: Your answers suggest low mood that is affecting your days a great deal. Talking to a specialist soon is recommended.

gad7.minimal: Your answers suggest few or no worry symptoms at the moment. Keep an eye on how you feel and check in again in a few weeks.
gad7.mild: Your answers suggest some worry or anxiety symptoms. Many people feel this way at times, and simple self-help steps often help.
gad7.moderate: Your answers suggest anxiety at a level where talking to a trained professional usually helps.
gad7.severe: Your answers suggest anxiety that is affecting your days a great deal. Talking to a trained professional soon is recommended.

who5.low: Your wellbeing score is lower than usual. A score on its own does not tell us why. Two short sets of questions about mood and anxiety can help you see more.
who5.typical: Your wellbeing score is in the range most people report. You can still answer the mood or anxiety questions if you want to.

clinicalCopy.doesNotMean: This is a screening questionnaire, not a diagnosis. Only a clinician can diagnose, and many things can raise a score for a while.
